notes: The ASV writes a word of its own (*that*) for the resuming `הִיא`, so that pronoun is not the unrendered occurrence rule 20 would otherwise leave `unrepresented`.
`לֶב אִישׁ` is recast as an English possessive, so the supplied determiner stands before the possessor's word and goes to `אִישׁ` under rule 29.
